name: Jeovani/Maxim Double-Pack Hack
description_html:
ATTENTION: Tier 1 is not unlocked until your PMC Is LEVEL TEN!!!

So. You’re here. It means you have a disregard for the way things are. I get it, I do. You don’t play by the rules. Why shouldn’t you get to have BOTH traders and BOTH questlines, huh? “This is SPT, let me do as I well please!”

Ok. Fine. Here are both Jeovani (1.2.0) and Maxim (1.0) with their quests unlocked for both factions. You can now do the quests, gain trader rep, and unlock their upper tiers of high quality ammo. The quests might not make sense in the new context, but hey, you get what you get when you play by your own rules.

For information on Jeovani, please check out his mod page here

For information on Maxim, please check out his mod pagehere

Dependency:

Virtual’s Custom Quest Loader is REQUIRED. You can download the latest version here. Installing out of date traders with the outdated version WILL BREAK COMPATIBILITY
